en: In the coming days, we might visit the exhibition about modern art, and my [[roommate]] [[does]] too, even though she rarely goes to galleries.
me: In the coming days, we might visit the exhibition about modern art, and
even though she rarely goes to galleries.
easy: does too는 앞의 visit(방문하다)을 대신한 말이다.
even though she rarely goes to galleries
비록 그녀가 갤러리에 거의 가지 않지만 (go 가다).
요약: 우리도 전시회에 갈지 모르는데, 룸메이트도 간다. 룸메이트는 갤러리엔 잘 안 가는데도.
notes: 앞의 일반동사 대신 → do/does/did (visit을 does가 대신함, is는 be동사라서 안 됨)
주어 my roommate는 3인칭 단수 → 현재형 does

en: Kevin cannot have finished his report last week because he hasn't even started it, and [[finishing all sections on time]] [[was]] never [[realistic]] anyway.
key: 모든 부분을 제시간에 끝내는 것은 현실적이지 않았다.
me: Kevin cannot have finished his report last week because he hasn't even started it, and
merel: finishing ... = 현실적이지 않은 것(주어가 보어와 같음)
easy: 요약: 모든 부분을 제시간에 끝내는 건 애초에 현실적이지 않았다.
notes: 동명사구(~하는 것)가 주어면 단수 취급 → 동사도 단수 (was)
동사 앞에 긴 말이 있으면 진짜 주어의 핵심(finishing)을 찾아 수를 맞춘다

en: Her [[friend]] [[suggested]] [[that she retrace her steps to find it]].
me: that she retrace her steps to find it.
easy: 그녀가 왔던 길을 되짚어 가는 것 (retrace 되짚다).
요약: 친구가 휴대폰을 찾으려면 왔던 길을 되짚어 보라고 제안했다.
notes: 제안·주장·요구·명령 동사 + that절 → 동사는 (should) + 동사원형 (retraces ✕ → retrace ○)
suggest 뒤에 that절이 통째로 목적어가 된다

en: You should book a table by tomorrow if you're going to the buffet this Friday, and the [[manager]] [[wants]] [[you]] [[to contact]] the restaurant directly to confirm.
me: You should book a table by tomorrow if you're going to the buffet this Friday, and
to contact the restaurant directly to confirm.
easy: The manager wants you to contact
요약: 매니저는 당신이 직접 식당에 연락해서 확인하길 바란다.
notes: want + 목적어 + to부정사 (want you to contact ○, want you contact ✕)
원형이 아닌 to부정사를 쓰는 동사: want, ask, tell, expect, allow ...

en: I could have joined the basketball team, but I chose to focus on my studies instead, and [[I]] [[did believe]] [[that decision was the right one for my future]].
key: 나는 그 결정이 옳다고 정말 믿었다.
me: I could have joined the basketball team, but I chose to focus on my studies instead, and
that decision was the right one for my future.
easy: that decision was the right one
요약: 나는 공부에 집중한 결정이 내 미래에 옳았다고 진심으로 믿었다.
notes: 강조의 do/does/did + 동사원형 (did believed ✕ → did believe ○)
did가 이미 과거를 나타내므로 뒤 동사는 원형

en: Professor Albert suggested that Dominic look for a recent article to write his paper, since [[Dominic]] [[must have struggled]] to find good sources on his own before this recommendation.
me: Professor Albert suggested that Dominic look for a recent article to write his paper, since
to find good sources on his own before this recommendation.
easy: Dominic은 분명 애를 먹었을 것이다(struggle 애쓰다).
to find good sources on his own
요약: 조언을 받기 전에 Dominic은 혼자 자료를 찾느라 분명 고생했을 것이다.
notes: 과거에 대한 강한 추측 = must have p.p. (must struggled ✕ → must have struggled ○)
before this recommendation처럼 지나간 때 표현이 단서

en: The [[customer]] [[demanded]] [[that delivery be completed within two weeks]], although the warehouse was already short-staffed that month.
key: 고객은 배송이 2주 안에 끝나야 한다고 요구했다.
me: that delivery be completed within two weeks,
although the warehouse was already short-staffed that month.
easy: that delivery be completed within two weeks
although the warehouse was already short-staffed
요약: 창고가 일손이 부족한데도 고객은 2주 안에 배송하라고 요구했다.
notes: although + 절(주어+동사), despite + 명사(구) → 절 앞에는 although
demand 뒤 that절은 (should) + 동사원형 (be completed)

en: Some people insist that they really saw a UFO, and my [[neighbor]] [[did]] too, describing it in vivid detail.
me: Some people insist that they really saw a UFO, and
merel: did too = saw a UFO도 대신함
easy: 요약: 어떤 사람들이 UFO를 봤다고 하는데, 내 이웃도 봤다며 생생히 설명했다.
notes: 앞에 나온 동사를 대신: 일반동사 → do/does/did, be동사 → be동사 (is가 아니라 does/did)
~, 동사ing는 '~하면서'라는 덧붙는 말 (describing)

en: My doctor proposed that I eat more vegetables with my meals, though [[I]] [[hardly had]] [[time to prepare fresh meals lately]].
key: 나는 신선한 식사를 준비할 시간이 거의 없었다.
me: My doctor proposed that I eat more vegetables with my meals, though
time to prepare fresh meals lately.
easy: 요약: 의사는 채소를 더 먹으라고 했지만, 나는 요즘 요리할 시간이 거의 없었다.
notes: hard = 열심히/딱딱한, hardly = 거의 ~않다 (뜻이 아예 달라요)
hardly는 일반동사 앞에 온다 (hardly had)

en: Frequent delays of flights suggest that the airline has financial or technical problems, and [[passengers]] [[must have waited]] for hours without any explanation last month.
key: 승객들은 분명 몇 시간을 기다렸을 것이다.
me: Frequent delays of flights suggest that the airline has financial or technical problems, and
for hours without any explanation last month.
easy: 요약: 지난달 승객들은 설명도 못 들은 채 몇 시간을 기다렸을 것이다.
notes: 과거에 대한 강한 추측 = must have p.p. (must waited ✕)
last month는 과거 시점 단서
